summary_en: This phase 2 study tests L19IL2/L19TNF, given into tumors, in people with locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (a skin cancer) who have progressed on or cannot tolerate immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment. The drug is injected into all injectable skin and subcutaneous lesions once weekly for up to 4 weeks, and a second 4-week course may be given if the best response is partial response or stable disease, per the treating physician. The main stated objective is to evaluate the activity of the treatment; the specific outcome measure is not stated, and patients are followed for up to 160 weeks.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa L19IL2/L19TNF, administrado dentro de los tumores, en personas con carcinoma cutáneo de células escamosas localmente avanzado (un cáncer de piel) que progresaron con un inhibidor de puntos de control inmunitario o que no lo toleran. El medicamento se inyecta en todas las lesiones cutáneas y subcutáneas inyectables una vez por semana, durante hasta 4 semanas, y se puede administrar un segundo ciclo de 4 semanas si la mejor respuesta es respuesta parcial o enfermedad estable, según el criterio del médico tratante. El objetivo principal indicado es evaluar la actividad del tratamiento; la medida específica de resultado no se indica, y los pacientes son seguidos hasta 160 semanas.
who_for: Locally advanced skin squamous cell carcinoma that progressed on or cannot be tolerated with immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment
At least one injectable, measurable skin or subcutaneous lesion
Age 18 or older with ECOG/WHO performance status of 2 or less
Willing to provide tumor biopsy tissue at screening and for response confirmation
not_for: Radiation therapy to tumor sites within 4 weeks before study drug
Current topical or systemic chemotherapy or immunotherapy
Known allergy to IL2, TNF, or other human proteins, peptides, or antibodies
